patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I was cleaning my own gun when it went off. Please do not tell my wife. The bleeding slowed after I pressed on it, but my arm hurts badly. I can still move and feel my hand.
presentation.triageNote: 41-year-old man with a single gunshot wound to the upper arm. Bleeding is controlled with direct pressure; pain is 8 of 10, and distal pulse, movement, and sensation remain intact.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because the penetrating mechanism and severe pain create a time-sensitive threat to limb function even though the patient is currently hemodynamically stable.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This is a penetrating extremity injury with severe pain and potential concealed damage despite controlled external bleeding and an intact initial neurovascular examination.
clinical.acuityReason: A gunshot tract can involve bone, artery, or nerve and may deteriorate through recurrent bleeding or swelling. Pain of 8 out of 10 also requires prompt assessment and relief.
keyFindings: Gunshot wound to the upper arm
Blood visible on the pressure dressing
Intact distal pulse, movement, and sensation
redFlags: Potential delayed bleeding, compartment pressure, or neurovascular injury
teachingPoints: Controlled external bleeding does not exclude deeper vascular, nerve, or bone injury.
A reassuring initial distal examination should be repeated because swelling or bleeding can evolve.

possibleDiagnoses: (maybe) Soft-tissue injury without deeper structural damage
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would receive imaging, serial neurovascular checks, pain control, wound and tetanus care, and specialty consultation, with discharge or admission determined by structural injury and bleeding risk.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
